[element-p]
=== `<p>` Paragraph

The basic block-unit of textual information; a textual paragraph.

#### Usage/Remarks
This element does not have to be a well-formed paragraph as defined in high school language class, i.e., “a block of text representing a single idea, typographically differentiated from its neighbors”. Rather, the element <<element-p,`<p>`>> is a block (as opposed to inline) structural unit which may be only a few words or letters in length.
